premises.text: Players can earn credit for engaging with their favorite websites.
premises.evidence_span: One True Fan is a service that gives players credit for showing love at their favorite websites

premises.text: Publishers want to better engage their most loyal users.
premises.evidence_span: Our customers are publishers who want to better engage their most loyal users.

premises.text: The service can be integrated easily into publisher websites.
premises.evidence_span: publishers can install a bit of JavaScript and immediately have their entire user base playing the game

premises.text: Users can track their engagement and earn points through a browser extension.
premises.evidence_span: we are both a website service and a browser extension

premises.text: True fans engage with websites differently and contribute significantly to page views.
premises.evidence_span: true fan's a small percentage of the overall traffic, but they make up a huge percentage of page views.

premises.text: Companies are currently focused on attracting one-shot traffic rather than engaging true fans.
premises.evidence_span: companies are spending millions of dollars every month engaged in SEO and social media optimization so that they can get more of this crappy one-shot traffic.

premises.text: The service will offer tangible rewards for user engagement.
premises.evidence_span: moving forward, we'll be offering tangible rewards for engagement.

premises.text: Partnerships with premier sites can help broker deals for rewards.
premises.evidence_span: each premier site that we partner with is another opportunity to start brokering those deals.

value.text: Users are recognized and rewarded for their loyalty and engagement with websites.
value.evidence_span: give players credit for their activities, and give them a bit of good-natured gameplay.

notes: No separate premises for the demo or alpha status; they are part of the overall service description.
